## Why visit

A genuine community-pub alternative to modern micropubs, with intimate rooms, local character and a view towards the Dee Estuary. Its 2025 Wirral CAMRA Community Pub Award supports its inclusion, while the cask choice makes it more than a scenic detour. Combine with The Beer Lab if exploring cider in Heswall, but factor in the distance from the railway station.

## Beer

Black Sheep Best Bitter and London Pride regularly listed, plus changing cask beers.
